svg.title: Cardenza — color components on white PCB
svg.desc: White PCB, flat colored STEP component geometry, original color silkscreen, dark keyboard legends, stadium switches with leads, 0603 LEDs, microphone sound port, simplified LCD frame and the approved TRACK1 screen. 88.9 x 50.8 mm, R1 mm border. All lettering is paths; no fonts or linked/raster assets.

g.inkscape:label: 04 · Straight key frames and stadium actuators
Original color silkscreen and dark keyboard legends
